name: uesf
description: UESF framework tooling exposed over the Model Context Protocol: skill validation, scaffolding, and the dependency graph.

implementation.note: Runtime server planned (roadmap R-06). This manifest is the contract; the tools it exposes are directly runnable today via CLI.

tools.name: uesf_validate
tools.description: Validate the whole framework against the UESF skill specification. Returns a report with per-skill errors and warnings, plus an overall verdict and exit code.

root.description: Framework root (defaults to the repository containing tools/).

tools.name: uesf_scaffold
tools.description: Create a new spec-conformant UESF skill skeleton from the template.

tools.name: uesf_graph
tools.description: Print the current skill dependency graph (resolution + edges) as text.

tools.name: uesf_list
tools.description: List the machine-checked skill inventory: id, category, kind, version, path.
